statements.notes: Read and follow directions carefully. Do not use if you have or develop diarrhea, loose stools, or abdominal pain because Cascara Sagrada may worsen these conditions and be harmful to your health.

WARNING: Limit use to no more than two weeks.
Not intended for use by persons under the age of 18. Keep out of reach of children.
Do not use if seal under cap is broken or missing.
NOTICE: This product contains Cascara Sagrada (Rhamnus purshiana).
